title: EPFL benchmark records: LUT-6 netlists improving the best known sizes
description: LUT-6 netlists improving the best size listed for the EPFL combinational benchmark suite. This version: sin with 991 LUTs and 103 levels (previous best 994 LUTs, F.-X. Reichl and F. Slivovsky), checked exhaustively on all 2^24 inputs. It starts from their published netlist and applies one standard ABC pass.
